title: IBPS PO MT XVI Online Form 2026 (7365 Posts) – Last Date Today
postName: Probationary Officer / Management Trainee – CRP PO/MT-XVI
vacancyDetails: 7365 PO/MT vacancies in 11 participating public sector banks under CRP PO/MT-XVI
qualification: Graduation in any discipline from a recognized University as on date specified in IBPS notification
ageLimit: 20 to 30 years (as on crucial date; category-wise relaxations as per IBPS rules)
selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Personality Test / Interview → Provisional Allotment
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID (Aadhaar), passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.ibps.in
2. Open CRP PO/MT-XVI Apply Online
3. Register with email and mobile
4. Fill form, upload photo/sign, pay fee
5. Submit and print application before last date 26 July 2026
shortDescription: IBPS PO/MT-XVI Online Form 2026 for 7365 posts. Apply by 26 July 2026 (extended). Prelims expected August 2026.
content:
IBPS has invited online applications for CRP PO/MT-XVI for 7,365 Probationary Officer / Management Trainee posts in participating banks.

Registration: 1 July 2026 to 26 July 2026 (last date extended). Fee payment also till 26 July 2026.

Highlights

  • Participating banks: 11 PSBs
  • Selection: Prelims → Mains → Interview
  • Apply only at ibps.in
